description: Fetch one guardrail by id or slug with its full checks and actions; use list_guardrails to discover ids first. Use before update_guardrail or delete_guardrail when you need the exact enforcement policy, and returns the full check and action configuration alongside status and ownership.

guardrail_id.description: The guardrail UUID or slug (with guard_ prefix) to retrieve

name: get_guardrail

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
